rules_text:
Rules summary Contents 1 Goal 2 Game Play 3 Itinerary Change 4 Missions (Rencontre) 5 End Game Scoring Goal Plays in 15 rounds (1 per day) Earn the most Victory Points by completing missions and collecting Location cards with smileys. Game Play Choose one of the following actions: 1. Voyager – Take 1 Location card, pay steps, gain symbols/reward 2. Rencontrer – Draw 2 Encounter cards. Discard 1 Encounter card from your hand. You do not have to discard 1 of the 2 you just drew. 3. Récupérer – Gain 4 Step tokens Itinerary Change At the start of Days 4, 8, 12 — discard and refresh all 8 Location cards. Missions (Rencontre) - Score if condition met (e.g., most of a symbol, 3 smiley cards, 6 Nord cards) - Fail = 0 pts; Succeed = earn smileys listed End Game Scoring After Day 15 1. Gain smileys from Encounter Cards (if the requirements have been met). 2. Gain smileys from your Location Cards. 3. +1 bonus per Encounter Card if ALL Encounter Cards are completed The player with the most points wins! Tiebreakers: most step tokens → shared win if still tied

---

Travel across France in 15 days and collect its most iconic sites, step by step!

What if you were just one step away from adventure?

15 Days is a set collection game that takes you on a journey to discover remarkable places in France.

Plan your itinerary to explore the country’s rich historical heritage, breathtaking natural landscapes, and the charm of picturesque villages.

Objective of the game: Earn as many victory points as possible by completing missions given by your Encounters.

With 15 Days, you embark on an adventure without a fixed route, but with one certainty: you have 15 days to make the most of your journey.
You won’t be traveling completely alone! Along the way, you will meet people who will share valuable advice on places to visit. These Encounter cards will guide you throughout your journey and help you claim victory.

Each turn, you can choose to:

Travel: Discover a new destination by collecting a Location card of your choice.
Meet: Draw from the Encounter cards to receive new recommendations.
Rest: Take a break to gain Step tokens.

The player who accumulates the most points at the end of 15 rounds wins the game!

It's a little bit too luck-based for me and I am quite sad that the cards are not as thematical as they could be but I see the appeal. Plus it's short so I think it can get out quite easily. [Rating: 5.5/10] The board refreshing every 4 turns is kind of bizarre, and it's not a very pretty game, but it's hard to go wrong with drafting and set collection.

[Rating: 6/10] Your aim is to buy cards that give you the icons to satisfy objective cards (this many icons, most of this icon, 1 pt for each of this icon, etc). You get 15 eponymous turns. On each, either draw more objectives (like tickets in Ticket To Ride), get more money , or buy a card from the 8-card display. That’s it. Each objective you buy is one less turn to accumulate cards/icons. It’s fine for a 15-minute light affair as long as you’re ok with the result being determined by getting lucky (or not) drawing into synergistic objectives.
